query:
Using LTX-2.3_ICLoRA_Union_Control V2V workflow: cartoon/comic-style inputs get realistic textures injected into the output.
Only affects stylized sources; realistic images work fine.

desired.outcome: Lower the IC-LoRA strength from 1.0 to 0.5 (value used in the official example workflow); OP confirmed this fixed the texture bleed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
